title: bro-pool build lanes accumulate cargo incremental state; incremental defeats sccache and nothing GCs target
wanted_capability: Pool-lane build hygiene: project_dispatch env for transcript-search should set CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 alongside RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache (incremental crates bypass sccache entirely AND leave per-session incremental dirs nothing prunes), plus a periodic target GC or cheap lane recycle (bpool lanes are ZFS clones of a gen with a warm seeded target; recreation is cheaper than letting divergence grow).
fallback_used: manual rm -rf of lane-bpool1 target/debug/incremental via pod exec 2026-07-28 (freed ~54G apparent; debug now 46G = seeded deps)
evidence: lane bpool1 (crane): target/debug/incremental 54G apparent across 1246 incremental dirs after 463 bh-test sessions 2026-07-26..28; ZFS USED 69.6G vs 15.5G sibling baseline
bpool3-6: zero bh-test sessions, pristine ~50G-apparent seeded target, 15.5G USED (clone-shared) - dispatch affinity pins all build/test load to bpool1 (warm-cache-friendly, but concentrates bloat)
fleet.json project_dispatch for transcript-search: RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache set, CARGO_INCREMENTAL not set (debug default on)
